export_controls.text:
This week in the House Foreign Affairs Committee, I sounded the alarm on growing national security risks tied to advanced AI chip exports and ongoing U.S. policy surrounding the war in Ukraine. 
 
Watch the full hearing below ⤵️ 
https://t.co/nru0BjAxNS
